user.title: 1 / 4 - Connection
user.description:
Select a known serial interface or enter the connection to the ventilation unit manually. The syntax automatically determines the connection type:

- **socket://ip_address:port**
Transparent serial network connection, e.g. a standard ser2net adapter.
- **/dev/ttyUSB...**
Local USB-to-serial adapter.
- **/dev/serial/by-id/...**
Stable path to a local serial interface.
- **/dev/...**
Other local or virtual serial interfaces, e.g. via `socat`.

ESPHome Serial Proxies are automatically offered by Home Assistant under the known serial interfaces. The Vallox/Helios DIGIT protocol always uses 9600 baud, 8N1.

data_description.known_connection: Local interfaces and ESPHome Serial Proxies detected by Home Assistant. A selection here takes precedence over the manual entry.

model.title: 2 / 4 - Device Name and Model
model.description: Enter a unique device name / entities prefix, and select your model to auto-populate device parameters (choose 'Custom' for manual input).

data_description.entity_prefix: Must be unique if multiple devices are configured (e.g. 'Basement vent', 'Upstairs vent', etc.)
data_description.device_model: Selecting a model will pre-fill the device parameters in the next step.

details.title: 3 / 4 - Device Parameters
details.description: Configure your ventilation parameters. Values have been pre-populated from the selected model. Can be changed later again.

data_description.airflow_per_mode: Exactly 8 integer values separated by commas, one per fan speed level (1-8), e.g. '60,90,120,150,180,210,240,270'.
data_description.power_per_mode: Exactly 8 integer values separated by commas, one per fan speed level (1-8), e.g. '10,18,25,34,50,75,117,185'.
data_description.heating_power: The power of the pre-heater or post-heater element in watts.

house.title: 4 / 4 - House Parameters
house.description: Enter the parameters of your house to calculate ventilation requirements. Can be changed later again.

data_description.house_area: The living area of your house in square meters (e.g.: 143).
data_description.house_volume: The air volume of your house in cubic meters (area x room height, e.g.: 384).
data_description.isolation_factor: House insulation quality factor: 0.3 = well insulated, 0.4 = standard, 0.5 = poorly insulated.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the ventilation unit. Please check the connection and adapter availability.
error.connection_required: Select a known serial interface or enter a connection manually.
error.invalid_connection: The connection is invalid. Use a known serial interface, `socket://host:port`, or `/dev/...`.
error.invalid_csv_count: Exactly 8 values are required (one per fan speed level), separated by commas.
